0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Dallas Mavericks visit the Houston Rockets. Dallas will be without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while Houston is missing Steven Adams (calf soreness). The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting came on January 31, 2026 in Houston, where the Mavericks lost 111-107.
